subject: Staggered acceptance schedule & case runbook
messages:
From: Diane Park <diane.park@medaxis.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: Ryan Holt <ryan.holt@medaxis.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: phased acceptance + acceptance test cases for pilot

Irene —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed with Ryan and the procurement team, we'd like to propose a staggered acceptance approach for the pilot so that we can move to a limited production slot earlier while running deeper validation in parallel. High level asks below; attaching a rough MAP and a starting set of test cases.

Top-level success criteria (what matters to us):
- Peak token latency p95 < 300ms for anonymized API calls under 10 RPS
- Response accuracy: intent-level concordance >= 92% on our clinical triage set (see attached)
- No PII leakage in prompts/responses — static scan and two-week manual review window
- Auditability: request/response logs retained for 90 days in our secure bucket

Proposed exit gates for limited production (phase 1):
1) Stability: 7 days of uninterrupted serving at target load with <1% 5xx
2) Latency: p95 below threshold across three synthetic runs
3) Security: completion of the brief SOC 2 artifact checklist we sent

We'd like Redwood to propose a concrete schedule and the acceptance test runbook that maps to each gate. Can you (a) confirm feasibility, (b) propose dates, and (c) call out any blocking prerequisites on your side?

Attached: 20251112_MAP_v1.xlsx, Eval-Test-Cases_v2.docx

Thanks,
Diane Park
VP, Digital Platforms | MedAxis Health

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@medaxis.com>, Ryan Holt <ryan.holt@medaxis.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: phased acceptance + acceptance test cases for pilot

Diane — thanks for the clear asks and the attachments. We're aligned on the high-level criteria and the staggered approach. Summary below and a proposed runbook attached.

Short answers: (a) feasible, (b) see proposed timeline, (c) blocking items listed under "prereqs."

High-level plan (proposed):
- Phase 0 (onboarding, week 0): onboarding, access, and baseline smoke tests (3 business days)
- Phase 1 (limited production, weeks 1–2): run limited production with sampling and active monitoring; acceptance criteria = your Phase 1 exit gates
- Phase 2 (validation, weeks 2–4): full evaluation test suite (concordance, stress tests, security checks)
- Phase 3 (go live ramp): post-acceptance cutover & SLA handoff

Key acceptance test cases (summary):
- Latency sweep: 3 runs at 10 RPS and 25 RPS synthetic, capture p50/p95/p99
- Concordance batch: 1,000 annotated clinical triage prompts (you provided) -> automated scoring vs baseline model
- PII scan: deterministic scanner + manual review (30 sampled responses per day for 7 days)
- Retention check: end-to-end log ingestion and access control validation (sandbox bucket)

Prerequisites on our side:
- Provisioning of a staging API key (we will provide temporary creds; please confirm IP allowlist)
- Access to the annotated test set in Drive (move to folder link you shared)
- Procurement confirmation on targeted start date for limited production window

I've attached a runbook: it maps each exit gate to an explicit test case, owner, and pass threshold. Attaching Eval-Test-Cases_v2.docx (updated) and the MAP spreadsheet with proposed dates.

Next steps: if this schedule looks good, let's lock week-of Nov 17 as Phase 0 and target Nov 24 for Phase 1 start. If procurement needs more time, we can shift.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Eval-Test-Cases_v2.docx (updated), 20251112_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: MDX-2387 - runbook owners + quick risks

Team — looping you in so owners are clear for the tests Diane requested. Note: Diane asked for a staggered acceptance so we need to prepare fast-turnaround artifacts for Phase 1.

Owners (proposed):
- Latency sweep & synthetic load: Ben Carter (bench infra + perf scripts)
- Concordance scoring & pairing: Marissa Cole (eval harness + scoring)
- PII scan & manual review process: Priyom Das (security liaison)
- Logs/retention check & bucket access: Irene Choi (ops + validation)

Immediate risks / blockers:
- IP allowlist: MedAxis asked for ours and will provide staging key only after we confirm IPs (need networking team input if there are NAT changes).
- Test set sanitization: Marissa, please confirm you can run the concordance scoring on the provided set without additional de-ident steps. If not, note the work estimate here.
- Procurement timeline: if procurement doesn't sign off by Nov 21, Phase 1 will slip one week.

Action items:
- Ben: share the perf script and an ETA for the first latency sweep (target: Nov 18)
- Marissa: confirm scoring path and ETA for cleaned annotations (target: Nov 17)
- Priyom: confirm manual review roster and evidence capture template (target: Nov 16)

I'll consolidate replies and push final MAP v2 to MedAxis by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks — Irene

From: Diane Park <diane.park@medaxis.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Ryan Holt <ryan.holt@medaxis.com>, procurement@medaxis.com
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: phased acceptance + acceptance test cases for pilot

Irene / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear owners. This looks doable. Quick confirmations:
- MedAxis procurement will be able to get the PO in place by Nov 21 (we're on track)
- IP allowlist: we'll provide the staging IPs by EOD Monday Nov 17
- Test set: Marissa — we can share a de-identified bundle; expect to upload by Nov 16

Two clarifications from our side:
1) Can Redwood run the latency sweep using our masked traffic generator (we will provide an endpoint and generator config) or do you prefer we run it and send results? We prefer Redwood-run so we can validate live metrics in your console.
2) For concordance scoring, we need a small exploratory report after Phase 1 (one-page summary highlighting top failure modes) — can you commit to that within 3 business days of the Phase 1 window close?

Proposed adjusted schedule (agreed on calls + our procurement timing):
- Nov 17–19: Phase 0 onboarding + baseline smoke runs
- Nov 24–Dec 1: Phase 1 limited production (sampling + latency sweep mid-window on Nov 27)
- Dec 1–Dec 12: Phase 2 full evaluation suite and manual review

If that works for you, please send a final MAP v2 with dates and a definitive list of what you will run vs what MedAxis will run.

Thanks,
Diane
VP, Digital Platforms | MedAxis Health
